variants.headline: New settlers land from the ship
variants.body: New settlers have landed from the ship at {district}. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.body: The district {district} has received new settlers landing from the ship. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
